verification.note: Read 56–62, 67, 75–77 completely; 63 opening, 68 through opening multicultural discussion, 74 tail; notes 1–25. Remaining body/notes unread. Landes/Ryan/Eley mediated through Fraser, their originals unread. Note 9 acknowledges Habermas knew alternative publics; 67 says counterpublics may exclude. Note 22 credits Spivak and Rita Felski for the combined term. Strong/weak publics distinguish decision from opinion, not moral rank. Suspect etymology and bibliographic dates not adopted. Addendum 2026-10-25: Addendum for Mary Ryan entry:61read, with59–62context. Fraser explicitly describes Ryan’s evidence of women’s associations, protest and multiple public arenas.
